cards.artworkDescription: A quick circle of chalk and candles that funnels a burst of stray leyline energy into the nexus

decks.name: Town of Millbrook
decks.description: Build a town from scratch: peasants work, buildings train them into an army, and the Town Chief mobilizes the population in emergencies.

decks.name: Blackrock Raiders
decks.description: No workers, no patience. Earn gold through violence: kill for bounties, burn buildings for plunder, and steal what the enemy saved.

decks.name: AX-01 War Machine
decks.description: You brought an army; I brought one machine. No units, no gold — just energy, modules, and one increasingly dangerous robot backed by its Landing Pad.

decks.name: Arcane Conclave
decks.description: A network of casters pooling mana into the Nexus. Counterspells, fading summons, and fireballs for everyone.

decks.name: The Restless Court
decks.description: Death is inventory. The Graveyard banks corpses; the Necromancer turns every casualty into power.

decks.name: The Brood
decks.description: Eggs hatch, larvae evolve, and everything is food. Wants its own units to die almost as much as yours.

decks.name: Shadow Guild
decks.description: Spies burrow under enemy buildings, secrets wait face-down, and gold changes pockets unseen.

decks.name: Alchemist Guild
decks.description: Weak bodies, strong chemistry. Freeze, dissolve, weaken and transmute the mighty into mutton.

decks.name: The Hunks
decks.description: Population is power. Grow your community, put every Hunk to work, and build an unstoppable city. Machines and beasts are useless without Hunks to crew them.

decks.name: Assembly Line Protocol
decks.description: Mass-produce cheap energy-powered drones from the Assembly Hub. Scrap feeds the furnace, jammer bots stall the enemy line, and the Foreman keeps the line rallied.

decks.name: The Grave Regent's Legion
decks.description: Every kill feeds the Citadel. Carrion ghouls bank corpses, sentinels leave skeletons behind, and the Regent turns a winning trade into a rallying cry.

decks.name: Incubation Swarm
decks.description: Breed a wide, biomass-fed swarm out of the Incubation Hive: nectar drones fuel the nest, buildings poison, pin and strip the enemy line, and Matriarch Vess keeps the whole brood healed and hunting.

decks.name: Undercity Exchange
decks.description: Run the guild out of a bank vault beneath the fish market: spies burrow into enemy buildings and crack them from inside, secrets and reactions punish anyone who swings at the boss, and every gold coin skimmed off the enemy pays for the next contract.

decks.name: Runecraft Ascendancy
decks.description: Conclave artificers hammer runes onto wargear and warded strongholds: equip your champions, out-ramp the enemy's nexus and grind them down with tempo tricks.
